name: Exp_Hans_Indicator_Cloud_System
summary: This EA implements the Hans Indicator Cloud System, a session-based breakout strategy that trades based on price breaking above or below a cloud (channel) formed by the Hans indicator. It identifies trading ranges during specific time windows and enters positions when price breaks out of the established cloud boundaries.
summary_zh: 该EA实现了Hans指标云系统，一种基于时段的突破策略。它在特定时间窗口内识别交易区间，当价格突破已建立的云边界时入场交易。
strategy_analysis: Hans指标云系统策略基于时段突破概念，核心是在特定交易时段（通常为亚洲/欧洲时段）内确定价格波动范围形成云带。入场条件为价格突破云带上轨时做多，突破云带下轨时做空，属于典型的区间突破策略。出场条件通常包括固定止盈止损或云带反向穿越。仓位管理采用固定手数或基于资金比例的方式。资金管理方面存在一定不足，未见到动态仓位调整或基于波动率的头寸规模计算。该策略的优势在于逻辑清晰、规则明确，但风险在于震荡行情中可能出现频繁假突破导致连续亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The Hans Indicator Cloud System strategy is based on a session breakout concept, where the core idea is to identify a price volatility range during specific trading sessions (typically Asian/European sessions) forming a cloud band. Entry conditions are going long when price breaks above the upper cloud boundary and going short when price breaks below the lower cloud boundary, representing a classic range breakout strategy. Exit conditions typically include fixed take-profit and stop-loss levels or reverse cloud penetration signals. Position sizing employs fixed lot sizes or account equity percentage-based methods. Money management has some deficiencies as there is no dynamic position adjustment or volatility-based position sizing calculation. The strategy's strength lies in its clear logic and well-defined rules, but the risk is that frequent false breakouts in ranging markets can lead to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: StopLoss
parameters.description_en: Stop loss in points, 0 means no stop loss

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points (unused; buy TP follows MA value)

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description_en: EA magic number for order identification

pros: 策略逻辑清晰简单，基于时段突破概念易于理解和执行
云带系统可视化效果好，交易者可以直观判断市场状态
突破策略在趋势行情中表现优异，盈亏比合理
基于时段的交易方式可以避免低流动性时段
系统化交易规则消除了主观判断的影响
pros_en: Clear and simple strategy logic based on session breakout concept, easy to understand and execute
The cloud system provides excellent visualization, allowing traders to intuitively judge market conditions
Breakout strategies perform well in trending markets with reasonable risk-reward ratios
Session-based trading avoids low liquidity periods
Systematic trading rules eliminate the influence of subjective judgment
cons: 震荡行情中假突破频繁，容易产生连续亏损
缺少动态止损和基于波动率的仓位管理机制
固定时间窗口可能不适应不同品种和市场条件的变化
未设置新K线检查可能导致同一K线内重复开仓
缺少点差过滤机制，在高点差时段入场成本过高
cons_en: Frequent false breakouts in ranging markets can lead to consecutive losses
Lacks dynamic stop-loss and volatility-based position sizing mechanisms
Fixed time windows may not adapt to different instruments and changing market conditions
Missing new bar check may cause repeated entries within the same bar
No spread filter, resulting in high entry costs during high-spread periods
improvements: 增加基于ATR的动态止损止盈机制，适应不同波动率环境
添加点差过滤和新K线检查，提高入场质量和避免重复交易
引入成交量或动量确认指标，减少假突破信号
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop-loss and take-profit mechanism to adapt to different volatility environments
Add spread filter and new bar check to improve entry quality and prevent repeated trades
Introduce volume or momentum confirmation indicators to reduce false breakout signals

risk_points: 假突破风险：震荡市中频繁触发突破信号导致连续亏损
止损为0时存在无限亏损风险
缺少新K线检查可能导致同根K线内重复开仓增加风险敞口
risk_points_en: False breakout risk: frequent breakout signals in ranging markets lead to consecutive losses
Zero stop-loss setting poses unlimited loss risk
Missing new bar check may cause repeated position opening within the same bar, increasing risk exposure

It identifies trading ranges during specific time windows and enters positions when price breaks out of the established cloud boundaries.
